entities.name: Basílica del Corazón de María, Santiago de Chile
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Basilica of the Heart of Mary is a Catholic Church in the city of Santiago, Chile. Built by the Claretians, it was inaugurated on 7 December 1879, being designated as a basilica in 1929 and as a National Monument of Chile on 14 January 1987.
